articles.title: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
articles.description: Michigan incumbent Shri Thanedar’s re-election bid against other Democratic candidates is getting more about crypto with an infusion of ads funded by an industry-aligned PAC.

articles.title: Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams more convincing
articles.description: Michael Coates, the foundation’s new CISO, said that AI vulnerabilities and fake identities will drive the next wave of blockchain security concerns.
